declared: 2026-11-07, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes. The drafts' lang-item and feature prerequisites were settled against rustc 1.98.0 in obj/parallel/census-batch6/repro first; each outcome follows the stated rule, not that exploration

core-pattern-dispatch.rs.reason: core's exact `impl<T: DispatchFromDyn<U>, U> DispatchFromDyn<pattern_type!(U is !null)> for pattern_type!(T is !null)` over type parameter bases

unbounded-pattern-dispatch.rs.reason: the same pattern-type DispatchFromDyn impl without the recursive T: DispatchFromDyn<U> bound

generic-pattern-field.rs.reason: a generic struct field `pattern_type!(T is !null)` over its own type parameter

non-null-pointer-dispatch.rs.reason: core NonNull shape: a repr(transparent) struct over `pattern_type!(*const T is !null)` implements DispatchFromDyn through the generic pattern impl and the raw pointer impl

missing-pattern-dispatch.rs.reason: opponent: the same struct without the pattern-type impl, so its field does not implement DispatchFromDyn (E0277)

pattern-to-pointer-dispatch.rs.reason: opponent: DispatchFromDyn from a raw pointer to a non-null pattern type changes the type's shape (E0377)

reference-base.rs.reason: a non-null pattern over a reference

integer-instance.rs.reason: a generic non-null pattern field instantiated at u32 in a signature
